verdict.rationale: gstack ships a router SKILL.md that explicitly 'sends any gstack request to the right skill (planning, review, QA, shipping, debugging, docs, security, design)' and each skill (review, qa, ship, cso, etc.) has its own SKILL.md description used for activation; domain-skills notes are also automatically injected into future session prompt context once learned, showing context-triggered activation beyond manual invocation. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence confirming trigger accuracy or that the 'right skill at right moment' selection reliably works in practice, and community discussion focuses on velocity/telemetry rather than skill-routing correctness.
